subject: APAC micro-region capacity request for Helios Labs — onboarding latency SLA
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@helioslabs.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: APAC micro-region capacity request for Helios Labs — onboarding latency SLA

Alex — thanks again for the demo last week. Helios' low-latency requirement for their APAC pilot is the one obvious blocker for us to move from POC to a paid Dedicated commitment. They need 95th percentile generation latency <120ms for conversational calls originating Singapore and Seoul.

To get a firm proposal back to them I need a quick internal alignment: Monica and Irene, can you confirm whether we can provision a small APAC micro-region pool (2 x A100-80GB equiv or 6 x A10s via burst) with prefix/KV cache priming so we can meet that 95p SLA at an expected concurrent session baseline of ~25 sessions? I uploaded Helios' forecast and latency sims to the Drive link below.

Attachments: helios_traffic_forecast_q4-q1.xlsx (forecast by endpoint/region)

Next steps I propose:
- Sizing confirmation + cost estimate (engineering + finance)
- Draft a 90-day onboarding MSA addendum with SLAs and an option to convert to a Dedicated pool commit
- Parallel security questionnaire (they've requested SOC2 evidence)

Alex — feel free to add anything from procurement that would change the sizing.

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@helioslabs.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@helioslabs.com
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 00:32:00 +0800
Subject: Re: APAC micro-region capacity request for Helios Labs — onboarding latency SLA

Marcus — appreciate the follow-up. Two clarifications from our side: first, the 25 concurrent sessions is conservative; peak could spike to 60 concurrent during A/B test windows. Second, we need tokens/sec guarantees for inference-heavy endpoints (summarization + reranking), not just session counts.

Procurement: we'll want a short-term reserved option for 3 months with a clear conversion path to a 12-month Dedicated contract if the pilot meets metrics. SOC2 evidence is fine — our security team will review the snapshot.

I'll wait for your sizing numbers.

— Alex
Head of ML Products | Helios Labs
alex.chen@helioslabs.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: APAC micro-region capacity request for Helios Labs — onboarding latency SLA

Folks — dug into the forecast. Important notes:
- Peak concurrency: plan for 60 concurrent sessions during tests (per Alex).
- Endpoint mix: 40% chat (streaming), 35% summarization (long-context non-streaming), 25% reranking (short high-throughput).
- Target latency 95p < 120ms requires local NVLink-class GPU for chat streaming; in our experience that maps to 2x A100-80GB equiv for consistent headroom or 8x A10s if we accept slightly higher variance.

Sizing options (rough):
1) Small micro-region (preferred): 2 x A100-80GB equiv, configured with aggressive KV caching + pre-warm for top-50 prefixes. Expected sustained capacity: ~40 concurrent chat sessions + reranking throughput ~800 qps at 50ms p50. Estimated monthly cost (hosted pricing uplift for regional exclusivity + standby): $65k/month.
2) Scale-out burst model: 6 x A10s with burst layering to handle test spikes to 60 concurrent. Lower base cost ($40k/month) but higher tail latency risk during concurrency spikes.

I'll attach latency simulation csv and a short runbook for priming cache. If procurement wants a 90-day reserved trial, finance will need a conversion discount schedule.

Attachments: latency_95p_simulation.csv

Happy to jump on a sizing call with Helios next day.

— Monica
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.com

---

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@helioslabs.com>, procurement@helioslabs.com
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: APAC micro-region capacity request for Helios Labs — onboarding latency SLA

Alex — thanks, Monica for the options. Per Helios' preference for predictability during product tests, here is our recommended path:

Proposal (for 90-day pilot):
- Provision: 2 x A100-80GB equiv in APAC micro-region (Singapore cluster) + reserved burst of 4 x A10 for test windows.
- Sizing rationale: meets 95p < 120ms target with KV cache priming, handles observed 60 concurrency spikes with burst pool.
- Financials: Pilot price $55k/month (one-time 10% pilot discount) for the 90-day period; conversion credit of 25% of pilot payments if they convert to a 12-month Dedicated commit within 30 days of pilot end.
- SLA: 99.5% availability for region, 95p latency objective for configured endpoints; detailed SLOs in MSA addendum.
- Security: SOC2 snapshot attached; we'll provide full audit logs on request.

Attachments: helios_traffic_forecast_q4-q1.xlsx, SOC2_snapshot_2026-06.pdf

Alex — does procurement want a simple DocuSign for the pilot MSA addendum or a PO to trigger provisioning? If PO, we'll need a signed acceptance and finance to set billing cadence.

Thanks,
Marcus

---

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: APAC micro-region capacity request for Helios Labs — onboarding latency SLA

All — approve the pilot terms as outlined. Action items:
- Monica: work with infra to reserve the 2x A100 and 4x A10 burst for the Singapore micro-region next week; provide expected lead time and provisioning checklist.
- Marcus: prepare pilot MSA addendum draft with the conversion credit clause and send DocuSign to Alex by Monday EOD. Include a simple billing PO path as alternative.
- Irene: flag Finance to expect HL-2026-099 pilot charge and pre-approve conversion discount mechanics.

Monica — please include the priming runbook and the latency simulation snapshot in the provisioning ticket so ops can pre-warm cache prior to cutover.

I'll escalate for any capacity conflicts if infra reports constraints.

Thanks,
Karthik
